description: Whether a Google Drive, OneDrive/SharePoint or Dropbox link opens for someone who isn't signed in, and one-click unsubscribes.

functions.name: access
functions.description: Visits the link without cookies or sign-in. status: public (anyone with the link), signin (needs an account with access), missing (no such file), or unknown; title: the file's name when public.

functions.name: unsubscribe
functions.description: One-click unsubscribe (RFC 8058): POSTs List-Unsubscribe=One-Click to the list's https address, without cookies. ok: the list accepted it.
